skill.name: excel-playbooks
skill.description: Use when the user asks what Manus can do with Microsoft Excel, WPS Spreadsheets, LibreOffice Calc, or Numbers, or needs a spreadsheet workflow routed by the workbook state that must survive. Covers creation, cleanup, extraction, analysis, dashboards, audits, repair, and automation; routes standalone files to Spreadsheets, open Excel workbooks to excel-live-control, finance methods to finance-pro-playbooks, and app-specific state only after capability and runtime checks.
skill.userDescription: Create, analyze, repair, and automate spreadsheet workflows.
exampleQuestions: Clean and analyze this Excel workbook.
Build a dashboard from my sales spreadsheet.
Help me repair formulas in this workbook.
